newsitem.title: USA: Clinton makes plastic frog hot seller in Florida.
newsitem.headline: Clinton makes plastic frog hot seller in Florida.

text.p: Plastic frogs have been leaping off the shelves at a toy store ever since one caught the eye of President Bill Clinton during a campaign stop this week.
The president calls his new toy "Radar Frog" and said he planned to have it stand guard outside the White House Oval Office, toy store owner Wes Dunn said on Friday.

Following a speech on Wednesday, Clinton and his aides wandered into Dunn's Daytona Beach shop, where the president spied the plastic frog that goes "ribbit" when something sets off its motion detector.
"I shook his hand and asked him if I could give him the nickel tour," said Dunn. "We spent about half an hour looking at toys, chatting about what he collects and what I collect."

Clinton mentioned that he collects frog toys and Dunn showed him the floor model of the toy frog. "He said, 'A Radar Frog! That's great. I'm going to put this right outside the Oval Office,'" Dunn said.

Ever since the presidential purchase, Dunn said customers have scooped up the rest of his frog supply. He said he has dozens of names on a waiting list and the manufacturer is shipping as many frogs as it can to his store.

During his shopping spree, Clinton also picked up a present for first daughter Chelsea -- a teddy bear with a U.S. flag on its sweater -- and a Christmas tree ornament in the shape of a white 1964 Ford Mustang, a presidential passion perhaps better known than his love of frogs.
